notes: GAIN is described both as genuine clinical skills education and as a commercial tool to 'drive penetration and increase loyalty', so it is scored as external education at level 3 rather than 4. GAIN ASCENT's 'business skills' component was considered for Entrepreneurship but is ancillary to clinical training, so Entrepreneurship stays at 1. A planned Hortolândia Center of Excellence (opening 2027) to train Latin American HCPs is planned and not scored. Camp Wonder funding totals ~2 million USD since 2012, but that figure sits in a separate paragraph from the quote.
